items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: She told me the name. I thought they called him . Lipposian.

ctx.x: Did Buddy ever have his own horn? He had it sometimes. Once in a while, huh?

Yeah. I don't know, he used to farm up there. He said, he had to borrow horns from everybody. He's lucky to get them. So he, he, I learned, I wasn't going to horn for him. I learned to him. And, uh, he was bringing back, uh, on Monday, next Monday. That, that, that wasn't my arm at all. I brought it off. I just brought the lens to bless the buzz like I didn't ever let the buzz get. And, uh, place, place was packed. Pack and jam with, with, with people. Copper is all too. And, uh, I, I, I knocked off at, uh, one…

I was freaking drunk, half drunk and spent all the money on the way. I knew he got nothing. I said, I don't want the arms. I got a good test. That's why I was like, I stepped on the table and pushed face. He was trying like he was on the table. He took a big dish, a big pan, a big old lousey and he killed that boy. I mean, bang! I was drunk again. He couldn't work. He got up and he was running outside. I said, oh, you're not hearing like that. I said, oh, you're not hearing like that.
